subject: Invoice aggregation & legal-entity handoff for renewal + expansion

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice aggregation & legal-entity handoff for renewal + expansion

Hi Alex —

As we finalize the renewal and the 2x capacity add-on that went live next quarter, Finance at Sunnova asked whether we can consolidate the two invoices into a single monthly invoice under your consolidated legal entity to simplify your AP flow. That would mean: 

- One invoice per month covering both the renewal commit and the expansion usage line items.
- A single PO number referenced on the invoice (you can supply an umbrella PO that covers both contracts), and
- Confirmation of the legal payee (and a W9) for the consolidated invoices.

We can sign a short amendment to formalize the invoicing change. If Sunnova can provide the umbrella PO and the W9 for the consolidated entity, we’ll update our billing system and route invoices to the finance contact you confirm. I attached a one‑page commit summary and a sample invoice template to show line item grouping.

Could you confirm: 1) the legal payee and billing email to receive PDF invoices, and 2) whether you’ll provide a single PO that references both the renewal contract and the capacity addendum?

If helpful we can send a DocuSign amendment to reflect invoice routing and the effective date for aggregation (suggested effective date: 2026-12-01 to align with your next invoice cycle).

Thanks — appreciate you moving this along.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Lead, Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: commit-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample-invoice.pdf (pdf)
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@sunnovalabs.com>

Cc: Bhavna Desai <bhavna.desai@sunnovalabs.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:02:37 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice aggregation & legal-entity handoff for renewal + expansion

Thanks Naomi — this is helpful. Sunnova is happy to consolidate invoices. Answers below: 

1) Legal payee: Sunnova Labs, Inc. (EIN: 27-3456789). Billing email: ap@sunnova.com.
2) We will provide a single umbrella PO that covers the renewal + expansion lines. I attached our PO (Sunnova_PO_78934.pdf) and the W9 for the consolidated entity.

A couple of notes from Finance: they want the consolidated invoice to list the contract IDs (your renewal + the capacity addendum) on the invoice for audit. Also please confirm whether each monthly invoice will show the per-token/unit usage detail or a single aggregated line — they prefer aggregated lines but need the invoice to be auditable.

DocuSign is fine for the amendment; please send the amendment and we’ll route to our procurement team. Goal: effective 2026-12-01.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex
Alex Nguyen
Director, IT Procurement
Sunnova Labs
alex@sunnovalabs.com
